page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.2xlarge is a dedicated virtual machine instance within the High Clock Speed instance family, built on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on the x86_64 architecture and is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance supplies 8 dedicated vCPUs alongside 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive and high-frequency computational tasks.

The hardware configuration features an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation without bundled local disk storage or hardware accelerators, having 0 GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Persistent storage and external networking require network-attached block storage volumes and external IP assignment.

Given its 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio paired with high base frequency processing cores, the instance provides strong resource density for configurations needing both rapid execution speeds and elevated memory footprints. It functions efficiently for memory-resident caching, in-memory databases, electronic design automation, batch computing, and enterprise application hosting.
